Name: TimeEq
Description: Find the total time, within a range, when an attribute value is equal to a specified value. Time returned is in seconds.

Arguments.name: attname
Arguments.description: The name of an attribute with a PI point data reference, enclosed in single quotation marks

Arguments.name: starttime
Arguments.description: time expression representing the beginning of a time range enclosed in single quotes; can be a relative time (such as '-3h') in reference to an absolute endtime

Arguments.name: endtime
Arguments.description: time expression representing the end of a time range enclosed in single quotes; can be a relative time (such as '+1h') in reference to an absolute starttime

Arguments.name: x
Arguments.description: The reference value of the search; must be an enumeration set (string), integer or real number

Returns: The total time (in seconds), within a range, when an attribute value is equal to a given value
Notes: Bad values are excluded from TimeEq calculation TimeEq

Example.description: [Find the total time between 12:00 and 1:00am today when 'att1' was equal to 80. Return the result in seconds]
[Find the total time in the past hour when the value of 'att1' was equal to the value at 8am today. Return the result in seconds]

Example.code: TimeEq('Temperature Status', '-1h', '*', "Normal") Expression Output Attribute (attribute mapped to a PI point) If 'Temp' > 500 THEN "HiLimit" ELSE "Normal" Temperature Status TimeEq('Temperature Status', '-1h', '*', "Normal")
Example.description: [Find the total time in the past hour when the value of the attribute 'Temperature Status' was equal to "Normal". Return the result in seconds]
[Find the total time in the past 24 hours when the value of 'enum_att1' was equal to "Normal". Return the result in seconds]
